text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: synthetic-prober-eu-west-ssl-handshake failing threshold exceeded (service: synthetic-prober, region: eu-west-1). 85 failures in 5m, error: TLS handshake timeout. Triggered at 2026-03-15T14:21:24Z

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-2982 fired for oncall schedule 'infra-sre' — escalation level 1. Paging Alex Kim (on-call). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-2982

Alex Kim: acked on PagerDuty. I'm looking — tagging eng-runtime and ops. Can someone pull the prober logs and the probe fanout stats for eu-west-1?

ops-bot: Fanout suppression toggled for synthetic-prober in eu-west-1 (reason: reduce noise). Command: `opsctl probes suppress --region eu-west-1 --duration 10m --reason "handing off to oncall"`

Marco Rivera: grabbing logs now. Early look: lots of `TLS handshake timeout` from prober against endpoint vip-synth.eu.internal:443. Rate of handshakes spiked ~14:18Z. Might be a downstream network/middlebox issue.

Alex Kim: good catch. Any recent infra changes in eu-west-1? Load balancer cert rotations or gateway ACL updates?

Jenny Zhao: Support: no inbound customer tickets yet. We do have increased 503s on the synthetic dashboard but prod traffic metrics look normal so far. I'll open a customer-impact ticket but low priority for now.

Marco Rivera: pulled a sample of raw prober output (trimmed):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-15T14:18:06Z","probe":"synth-abc","err":"tls: handshake timeout","target":"vip-synth.eu.internal:443","rtt":null}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T14:18:07Z","probe":"synth-def","err":"tls: handshake timeout","target":"vip-synth.eu.internal:443","rtt":null}
```
No obvious cert validation errors, just timeouts.

Alex Kim: trying a quick test from runbook node: `curl -v https://vip-synth.eu.internal/health -I` — getting `* TLS handshake timeout`. Reached out to cloud-net for network path check.

ops-bot: Temporary mitigation applied: routed probes away from VIP to fallback endpoint `vip-synth-backup.eu.internal`. Config diff: `prober.routes.eu-west-1.priority=backup` (rolled for synthetic-prober only).

Priya Patel: I'm joining as backup SRE. Taking over paging. Alex, do you want to handoff?

Alex Kim: Handing off to Priya — I need to step into another pager. Priya, context: suppression in place, probes routed to backup, logs show TLS timeouts to VIP. No customer reports. Follow-up ticket INC-2026-ssl-handshake created and assigned to eng-runtime.

Priya Patel: acked on PagerDuty. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with cloud-net and eng-runtime. Marco — can you try a controlled re-run of targeted probes against VIP with increased verbosity? Add `--tls-dump` and collect SNI/ClientHello timing.

Marco Rivera: running targeted repro (5 procs) now with `--tls-dump --timeout 8s`. Will post results in ~2m.

Marco Rivera: quick dump snippet:
```
ClientHello SNI: vip-synth.eu.internal
ClientHello cipher suites: [TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 ...]
Server response: SYN/ACK, then no TLS ServerHello within 6s
```
Seems TCP completes but TLS handshake stalls.

Jenny Zhao: Support: flagged customers using eu-west telemetry for closer watch. Notifying enterprise customers with ops contacts: some scheduled jobs might see synthetic alerts; advising monitoring only at this stage.

Alex Kim: tagging eng-runtime @Marco — any recent prober client library changes pushed in last 24h? Could this be client-side regression?

Marco Rivera: checked commits — no prober client change in last 48h. There was a platform LB change 16h ago (TLS termination PATH rewrite) but rollback requests show unchanged config. Eng infra is validating load balancer health.

ops-bot: Cloud-net reported transient BGP flap around 14:17Z affecting subset of routes to eu-west-1 VIPs; packet loss observed on path to vip-synth.eu.internal.

Priya Patel: OK that's consistent. Current mitigation steps are: 1) suppress probe fanout (done), 2) route synth probes to backup (done), 3) continue to monitor. If cloud-net indicates full restoration, we'll slowly unroute probes back and watch.

Jenny Zhao: Support note: no active customer incidents. I'll hold on customer comms until we see sustained failures >15m.

Marco Rivera: cloud-net says routes stabilized at 14:28Z. I ran another TLS dump against VIP — handshake completes now within 120ms.

Priya Patel: un-routing probes back to VIP on a gradual rollout: `opsctl probes route --region eu-west-1 --strategy gradual --percent 10 --duration 5m` — rolling now. Monitoring for handshake timeouts and error spike.

ops-bot: Gradual rollout started: 10% -> will increase to 50% -> 100% if no regressions.

Marco Rivera: monitoring: first 10% tranche shows no TLS timeouts; 5xx synthetic failures remain at baseline.

Priya Patel: good. I'll keep the PD incident open for a bit and close after 30m stable. Next steps/tickets: INC-2026-ssl-handshake (eng-runtime) doc updated with timeline, cloud-net asked for RCA. Postmortem owner: Marco Rivera.

Alex Kim: thanks team — handing back to Priya.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-2982 acknowledged by Priya Patel. Escalation paused.

Priya Patel: closing note: follow-up actions: 1) cloud-net RCA and export of BGP events; 2) add probe fanout backoff during transient network instability in prober runbook; 3) ensure synthetic alert thresholds consider transient network noise. I'll update INC-2026 in 1h.

support-bot: Customer-impact ticket SUP-724 created (priority: P3, status: monitoring).

incident-bot: Incident thread summary queued.

Priya Patel: PD: will resolve after 30m of stable checks. For now leaving thread open for any late regressions. :white_check_mark:
